# Connection pool exhaustion on the auth service, not the database

Login requests hang and time out during peak; the database itself looks healthy.

Unlike the payment-service incident, here the pool max (20) was simply undersized for peak login concurrency; the database had plenty of headroom, so the fix was pool sizing, not a leak.

1. Confirm the DB is healthy and the bottleneck is the app-side pool
2. Increase the Hikari maximumPoolSize within the DB's connection budget
3. Add a queue timeout and backpressure on login
4. Load-test peak login concurrency to validate the new size

Error Details
```
HTTP 503; 'Timeout acquiring connection from pool'; HikariPool waiting=61 active=20 max=20; but pg_stat_activity shows only 20 sessions
```

Tags: auth, connection-pool, hikaricp, 503, pool-sizing
